map.本工具用于检测（张力/长度/寿命）服务的合法性校验，依据对应数据格式与语法规范实: This tool validates the (tension / length / life) testing service against the corresponding data format and syntax rules in real time, locating errors; it runs entirely in the browser and uploads no data.
map.📚 深度解析：带/绳类三项检测判定（张力/长度/疲劳）: 📚 Deep Dive: Three-Item Test for Belts/Cords (Tension / Length / Fatigue)
map.传动带/绳索自检：按张力强度、长度偏差、疲劳寿命三项判定: Belt/rope self-check: judge by three items — tensile strength, length deviation, fatigue life
map.安全裕度：疲劳寿命是耐久核心: Safety margin: fatigue life is the core of durability
map.逐项判定：张力强度≥500N、长度偏差≤2%、疲劳寿命≥5×10⁵ 次；三项均满: Item-by-item: tensile strength ≥ 500 N, length deviation ≤ 2%, fatigue life ≥ 5×10⁵ cycles; all three satisfied = pass. Tension sets load capacity; length deviation sets installation; fatigue sets life.
map.张力 600N（≥500 ✓）、长度偏差 1%（≤2 ✓）、疲劳 6×10⁵ 次: Tension 600 N (≥500 ✓), length deviation 1% (≤2 ✓), fatigue 6×10⁵ cycles (≥5×10⁵ ✓): all three pass → qualified. If tension drops to 450 N it fails, insufficient load capacity.
map.该值为示例合格下限，对应中等寿命；关键传动/起重须更高并留安全系数，按载荷谱与: This value is an example pass lower limit for medium life; critical drives/hoists require higher with a safety factor, determined by load spectrum and S–N curve.
map.偏差大导致张紧不均、跳齿或打滑；≤2% 为常见安装允差，同步带等更严，须按节距核: Large deviation causes uneven tensioning, tooth jumping, or slipping; ≤2% is a common installation tolerance, stricter for timing belts — calculate by pitch.
map.拉伸试验需控制拉伸速度: Tensile tests require controlling the tensile speed
map.长度偏差测试需多点测量取平均: Length-deviation tests require multi-point measurement and averaging
map.关于「检测（张力/长度/寿命）服务」: About the Tension / Length / Life Testing Service
map.带材张力强度、长度偏差、疲劳寿命三项检测工具，依据GB/T 3923、GB/T: A three-item testing tool for belt tensile strength, length deviation, and fatigue life, judging pass/fail per standards such as GB/T 3923 and GB/T 4669. Suitable for mechanical-property testing of conveyor belts, webbing, and wires.
map.支持张力强度、长度偏差、疲劳寿命等多项指标检测: Supports testing of multiple indicators including tensile strength, length deviation, and fatigue life
